role: Data Science Intern
jd:
Hiring: Data Scientist | Remote – Canada
We are hiring a skilled and motivated Data Scientist on behalf of one of our clients for a fully remote opportunity.
The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, hands-on experience with data science tools, and the ability to transform complex datasets into actionable business insights.
Job Title: Data Scientist
Location: Canada
Work Mode: 100% Remote


Key Responsibilities

- Gather, clean, transform, and analyse large datasets from diverse sources to generate meaningful business insights.
- Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, correlations, and potential business opportunities.
- Design, develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models for predictive analysis and forecasting.
- Apply statistical methods, data modelling, and hypothesis testing to support data-driven business decisions.
- Develop predictive algorithms and analytical solutions to address real-world business challenges.
- Design interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualisations using Power BI, Tableau, Matplotlib, or Seaborn.
- Extract, manipulate, and manage data using SQL, with a focus on writing efficient and optimised queries.
- Use Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and SciPy for data analysis and machine learning.
- Identify, investigate, and resolve data inconsistencies to ensure data accuracy, quality, and reliability.
- Collaborate with data engineers, business analysts, software developers, and cross-functional teams.
- Translate business requirements into actionable analytical solutions and present findings to key stakeholders.
- Evaluate model performance, fine-tune algorithms, and continuously improve predictive accuracy.
- Automate data preparation, processing, and reporting tasks to streamline analytical workflows.
- Perform feature engineering and feature selection to enhance model efficiency and performance.
- Maintain detailed documentation of analytical approaches, modelling techniques, workflows, and project deliverables.
- Adhere to data privacy, security, governance, and compliance standards while handling sensitive information.




Required Skills & Qualifications

- Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
- Good understanding of statistics, probability, and machine learning algorithms.
- Hands-on experience with Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and data visualisation libraries.
- Familiarity with Power BI or Tableau.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- A degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field is preferred.


Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with real-world datasets, predictive modelling, and advanced statistical techniques.
- Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- Knowledge of deep learning frameworks, including TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras.
- Exposure to Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, and Generative AI applications.
- Understanding of big data technologies such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, and Databricks.
- Experience working with ETL processes, data integration, and automated data preprocessing pipelines.
- Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Snowflake.
- Knowledge of deploying machine learning models using Flask, FastAPI, Docker, or cloud-based platforms.
- Understanding of MLOps concepts, including model deployment, version control, performance monitoring, and lifecycle management.
- Experience with Git or other version control tools for collaborative development and project management.
- Familiarity with A/B testing, experimental methodologies, and business performance measurement.
- Ability to analyse time-series datasets and apply forecasting, trend analysis, and anomaly detection techniques.
- Experience building scalable, efficient, and production-ready machine learning solutions.
- Awareness of responsible AI principles, model interpretability, fairness, and bias detection.
- Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
- A portfolio showcasing data science projects, research initiatives, or open-source contributions will be an added advantage.

jd:
Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

We're searching for a Summer 2027 Software Engineer Intern for our Vehicle Platforms Team. This role is a unique opportunity for a systems-minded coder to work at the foundational layer of our autonomous trucks, bridging the gap between high-level autonomy software and physical vehicle hardware. You will be instrumental in ensuring our sensors, compute units, and embedded devices function as a seamless, high-performance unit, making this one of the most hands-on software roles at Aurora.

In this role you will



- Integrate Core Hardware Components: Write and maintain C++ interfaces and drivers that integrate Lidars, Radars, Cameras, and other embedded devices into the Aurora Driver stack.
- Support Platform Bring-up: Participate in the initial software "bring-up" of new vehicle platforms, ensuring the onboard compute and sensors are correctly configured and communicating.
- Optimize Onboard Performance: Profile and optimize code to ensure efficient use of limited CPU, GPU, and memory resources on the vehicle.
- Monitor Hardware Health: Develop and refine software tools that track the real-time health and telemetry of our hardware components to ensure safe fleet operations.
- Validate via HIL Infrastructure: Utilize Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments to test and verify your code changes against real-world hardware before deployment to the road.

Required Qualifications



- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Strong proficiency in C++: Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and memory management (academic or project-based).
- Hands-on Systems Experience: At least 1–2 years of relevant experience, which can be demonstrated through multiple internships, significant academic research, or professional work involving hardware-software interaction.
- Linux Fundamentals: Experience working in a Linux environment with an understanding of command-line tools and system basics.
- Exposure to Networking Protocols: Familiarity with the basics of data transport, such as TCP/IP, UDP, or serial communication.

Desirable Qualifications



- Robotics or Embedded Projects: Experience with ROS/ROS2, microcontrollers (Arduino/STM32/ESP32), or hobbyist robotics.
- Familiarity with Sensors: Prior exposure to Lidar, Radar, or Camera data processing and hardware interfaces.
- Scripting Skills: Proficiency in Python for automation, data analysis, or building internal support tools.
- Automotive Knowledge: Understanding of CAN bus protocols or Automotive Ethernet basics.
- Safety Mindset: Familiarity with concepts of high-availability or safety-critical software design.

Compensation

The hourly pay rate for this internship in Mountain View is:



- $52.00 per hour for interns pursuing a bachelor’s degree; and
- $58.00 per hour for interns pursuing a master’s degree

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.
